title: Executive certificate in theology
summary: Intensive executive program for foundational theological understanding.
fullDescription: The Executive certificate in theology offers a concentrated curriculum for leaders seeking a robust foundation in biblical truth and institutional governance. This program bridges the gap between traditional scholarship and modern leadership needs.

title: Diploma in theology
summary: Comprehensive diploma program for aspiring ministers and scholars.
fullDescription: A rigorous two-year program focusing on systematic theology, hermeneutics, and church history. Ideal for those starting their theological journey with a commitment to academic excellence.

title: Associate degree in theology
summary: Foundation degree program combining theology and general studies.
fullDescription: This program provides a well-rounded education, integrating core theological studies with broader academic disciplines. Perfect for students preparing for a Full Bachelor's degree.

title: Bachelor Degree in theology
summary: Undergraduate degree for professional ministry and higher scholarship.
fullDescription: Our flagship undergraduate program offering deep immersion into biblical languages, advanced theology, and ministerial practice. Accredited and recognized for excellence in theological education.

title: Masters in theology
